During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], a group of farmers on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] helped a hidding Falon Grey from being discovered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. These '''rebels''' opposed the Imperial forces in a [[Battle of Dantooine (Imperial Period)|short battle]] there. Led by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Falon Grey]], they fought an attack force of Imperial troops on their [[Unidentified Dantooine village|village]]. The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[X2]] defected and helped Grey and the rebels, but an Imperial counterattack led by [[X1]] killed Grey and the rebels, resulting in an Imperial victory.<ref name="BII" />
